Team / Elena —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. We're moving ahead with a small, invitation-only CFO roundtable in SF on Tue Nov 16 (evening). Goal: peer dialog on cost optimization and inference economics; 10–12 guests (mix of fintech + commerce CFOs).

Action items I want to nail this week:
- Finalize the proposed invite list (attached: guest_list_proposal.csv) — please flag any conflicts or duplications.
- Confirm venue hold and provisional menu; see attached Venue_Quote_20261005.pdf (Marcus, can you confirm platinum hold and whether we can get a private room add-on?).
- NDA workflow: we require a short mutual NDA for guest list review and pre-read circulation. Elena — is FinAly comfortable with an e-sign DocuSign flow? I can send a pre-filled DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Logistics notes: 6:15pm arrivals, 6:45pm dinner start, 8:45pm close. We will provide a two-course seated menu + 1 vegetarian option and one gluten-free option. If dietary notes come in earlier, we'll pass to the venue.

Please reply with: (1) accept/reject for each proposed guest, (2) any NDA exceptions, and (3) Marcus — confirmation on the venue hold cadence.

Thanks —
Marissa
